title: Protein pasta with Rao's and ground beef, roasted broccoli
ingredients: 2 lb broccoli crowns, cut in florets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the broccoli with oil, salt and pepper and roast about 20 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Boil the pasta in salted water per the box.
Meanwhile brown the beef in a large pot, breaking it up. Drain if needed, add the Rao's and simmer until the pasta is ready.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and serve with the broccoli.
